The source requires at least one setting although each parameter is individually optional; supply one or more. Timeout is seconds; block, retry, purge and record-expiry durations are minutes. Block time is at most 240 minutes, retry time 1440 minutes, and record expiry 43200 minutes. Child timeout, process count and purge interval affect the daemon and should change only when necessary.
Changes server-wide mail deferral policy. Trusted IP addresses bypass Greylisting; untrusted addresses can be deferred. No client retry or rollback is provided.

description: Server-wide mail operations, including Greylisting policy, trusted hosts, common providers and deferred triplets. Trust and configuration changes alter mail deferral policy. Returned triplets contain sender and recipient addresses; the client does not deliver mail or fetch returned addresses.
